subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this consent-bound Claws installation lifecycle and land the stacked RFC slices in their current shared-SQLite design?
rationale: The patch is a new mutating CLI and persistent lifecycle contract, not a bounded bug fix; automation cannot decide whether this should become an OpenClaw-owned product surface or define its permanent landing sequence.

options.title: Sponsor ordered landing
options.body: Confirm the Claws lifecycle as an experimental core direction, require exact-head recovery proof, and land the prerequisite and dependent slices in reviewed order.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Keep only the read-only schema and planning surface until maintainers settle mutation, provenance, recovery, and removal contracts.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold these PRs until the RFC has an explicit owner and an agreed end-to-end lifecycle design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor ordered landing
recommendation.body: Confirm the Claws lifecycle as an experimental core direction, require exact-head recovery proof, and land the prerequisite and dependent slices in reviewed order.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline explicitly routes the feature discussion to this person, making them the best available candidate to confirm sponsorship or redirect the decision.
